sn51.14:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
sn51.14:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū heṭṭhā migāramātupāsāde viharanti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā.
sn51.14:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi
sn51.14:2.2: ete kho moggallāna sabrahmacārino heṭṭhā migāramātupāsāde viharanti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā
sn51.14:3.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato paṭissutvā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā pādaṅguṭṭhakena migāramātupāsādaṃ saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampacālesi.
sn51.14:3.2: atha kho te bhikkhū saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu
sn51.14:3.3: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn51.14:3.4: nivātañca vata ayañca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampi atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālitoti.
sn51.14:4.1: atha kho bhagavā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca
sn51.14:4.2: kinnu tumhe bhikkhave saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekamantaṃ ṭhitāti.
sn51.14:4.4: nivātañca vata ayañca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampi atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālitoti.
sn51.14:4.5: tumhe ca kho bhikkhave saṃvejetukāmena moggallānena bhikkhunā pādaṅguṭṭhakena migāramātupāsādo saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito.
sn51.14:4.7: katamesaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvoti.
sn51.14:4.8: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn51.14:5.2: catunnaṃ kho bhikkhave iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo.
sn51.14:5.4: idha bhikkhave moggallāno bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati …pe…
sn51.14:5.8: iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati na ca atipaggahitā bhavissati
sn51.14:5.9: na ca ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittā bhavissati na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati
sn51.14:5.11: yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure
sn51.14:5.12: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho
sn51.14:5.13: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā
sn51.14:5.14: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.14:5.15: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo.
sn51.14:5.16: imesaṃ ca pana bhikkhave catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti. imesaṃ
sn51.14:5.17: ca pana bhikkhave catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
